items.title: Frank Gillette’s Anthropic Blues
items.summary: Elegiac, urgent, and infinitesimal, the videos and Polaroids in "Spectra Obscura" express distinct sorts of disappearance, decay, and fleeting natural phenomena.

items.title: Medical Imaging and Art Meet in the Exhibition “Overexposed”
items.summary: The concurrent emergence of cinema and X-ray technology radically transformed how we see and understand the human body.

items.title: I Wanted a Different Betty Parsons Exhibition
items.summary: It might have made a more fascinating exhibition to explore her balancing act as a gallerist, but this show focuses on her less interesting art.
